chapter: Playing in clubs and Mardi Gras
title: Brass band lineup and whether they read music
summary: Brunies and Allen list the instruments in the brass bands and say that Fisher and Laine's players mostly did not read music.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: And Abby and Abby. Yeah, Abby was at the Cadillac. Later, the silver slipper of the... Silver slipper, too. I was going to ask one more question about the brass bands. What the lineup was. Like you say, sometime you were the only carnet. How many trombones? What else did they have? Altos, clarinets? Two trombones, tuba, two altos, bass drum, snare drum, two clarinets.
Sometimes two or three French horns.
French horns. Yeah. Would it be real French horns or like the alto, melaphone? Yeah. That go around in a circle. Yeah. The clarinets, did they have E-flat or B-flat?
Some of them had B-flat. Some of them had E-flat. First, second, and third. I imagine them. First, second, and third, fourth, trumpet, crack, trumpet. I used to blow all that out at one time.
When you played with those bands like Fishers or Pop Elaine, did you have any music ever? The other fellas, did they use music? No, no. Just all but him. All but him. Super.
